---

output: html_document
params:
  panel_file: !r file.path(ifelse(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE") != "", Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE"), path.expand("~")), "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data", "finalized_design_v1", "section2", "section2_panel.rds")
  schedules_dir: !r file.path(ifelse(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE") != "", Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE"), path.expand("~")), "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data", "finalized_design_v1", "section2", "draws", "did")
  output_dir: "section2_output"
  cores: 0
---

This notebook reproduces Section 2 of *Effect of Centralized School Choice on College Admissions
Outcomes* (Rios, Larroucau and Marar): Table 1, Figure 1 (its two event-study panels), Appendix
Tables A1 and A2, and the numbers Section 2's text quotes (the event-time estimates, the joint
randomization tests of the leads, the check on the largest GPA lead, and the panel's counts).

**Inputs.** The notebook reads its inputs from the coauthors' shared Dropbox folder
`<home>/Dropbox/Effect SAE on SUA/data/finalized_design_v1/section2/` (`<home>` is `USERPROFILE` on
Windows and `~` on macOS and Linux) and checks each input by its MD5 before it reads it.

- `section2_panel.rds` (`params$panel_file`): Section 2's panel, one row per entrant child-year in
  an over-demanded school-grade, academic years 2012-2023; 1,324,477 rows, 8,891 school-grades,
  MD5 `3104b4b2b1b6998941311667fa0ab785`. Its columns are listed in the data dictionary below.
- `draws/did/regional/` (under `params$schedules_dir`): 14 files of saved reassignments of SAE's
  rollout across the 16 regions, 9,999 or 2,999 each, that the randomization tests use.

**Command.** From the folder that holds this notebook (see the README):

    Rscript -e "knitr::knit('section2_cs_did.Rmd')"

This writes `section2_cs_did.md` (code, printed results, warnings and messages) and the folder
`section2_output/`: `tables/` (the three table files the paper inputs), `figures/` (Figure 1's two
panels), `staggered_did/` (every intermediate file and result) and `draws/bootstrap/` (the
bootstrap draws, drawn anew from the seeds below; the folder must start empty, so a second run
needs `section2_output/` removed first). `params$cores` sets the number of processes (0: every core).

**Run time and memory.** On a Windows 11 machine with 20 cores and 64 GB (R 4.5.1), with every core
(`cores: 0`): 2.5 min, the knit and its worker processes holding 5.4 GB together at the peak. On 4
processors (`cores: 4`): 4.3 min and 1.9 GB. With one core (`cores: 1`): 14.2 min and 1.1 GB.

**Versions.** R 4.5.1 and did 2.1.2 are required; the notebook stops otherwise. Any current version
of data.table and knitr works; the notebook prints the versions it runs with.

**The rules the panel embodies.** The project's pipeline built the panel from the administrative
records under these rules (Section 2.1, "Over-demanded schools, entrants, and outcomes"):

- *Over-demanded school-grades.* A school-grade is in the panel when effective demand exceeded the
  seats it offered in the main stage of every SAE process from 2016 through 2025 in which it
  offered seats. Magallanes's first process, in 2016, counts.
- *Schools left out.* A school that moves between publicly funded and fee-paying status at any
  point in 2012-2025, read from the dependency code on its students' year-end records, is left out
  whole.
- *Grades.* Every youth secondary program's census rows carry their grade, including the program
  codes SAE's applicant file does not list.
- *Entrants.* An entrant is a child in the school's census in year $t$ who is absent from that
  school's census in year $t-1$, in any of its programs.
- *Prior-year GPA.* Each entrant's GPA of year $t-1$ is the mean of her graded year-end records that
  year (GPA from 1 to 7), standardized over every graded student in Chile that year, one value per
  student; a record without a student ID counts as its own value.

The notebook's own code applies four more: the GPA outcome covers entrants to grades 2-12 (the
PreKinder, Kinder and 1st-grade cell-years are left blank), the Observations rows count the
cell-years of 2012-2020 (the years the estimates use), Appendix Table A1 has five specification
rows and the restricted-sample row, and the largest GPA lead is recorded against 0.03 SD.

**Data dictionary.** Section 2's panel (one row per entrant child-year):

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `MRUN` | the child's student ID (the census's own name) |
| `AGNO` | the academic year $t$ of the census in which she enters |
| `RBD` | the school's ID (the census's own name) |
| `COD_NIVEL` | the grade she enters: -1 PreKinder, 0 Kinder, 1-8 grades 1-8, 9-12 secondary grades 1-4 |
| `REGION` | the school's region, 1-16 (13 is the Metropolitan Region) |
| `IS_ENTRY` | 1 for the grades a child usually enters a school at (PreKinder, Kinder, 1, 7 and 9) |
| `DOOR` | the year of the first SAE admission process with offers in the cell's region and grade; that process assigns the class entering in `DOOR + 1` |
| `SLACK_FAIL` | TRUE when the pre-adoption enrollment check flags the cell: the grade's mean enrollment in the four years up to `DOOR` is below 90% of its mean in the three years after, while the school's enrollment shows no such rise (Appendix Table A1's row "Slack cells excluded") |
| `DOOR_YEAR_TAG` | TRUE when the cell turned applicants away in its first SAE process (carried for reference; no exhibit here uses it) |
| `PRIO` | 1 when the child is on the low-income (prioritario) roster of year $t$ |
| `PRIOR_GPA_Z` | her prior-year GPA, as defined above; NA when she has no graded record in $t-1$ |
| `N_PRIOR_RECORDS` | the number of her graded records in $t-1$ (NA when none) |
| `UNKNOWN_SCHOOL`, `UNKNOWN_REGION`, `UNKNOWN_GRADE`, `UNKNOWN_CALENDAR` | TRUE when one of her records of $t-1$ lacks a school, the school's region, a grade, or the first SAE process of that region and grade |
| `EXPOSURE_KNOWN` | TRUE when none of the four is missing for any of her records of $t-1$ |
| `EXPOSED` | TRUE when one of her records of $t-1$ was earned in a region and grade SAE already covered |
| `SIGNATURE` | the regions and entry-grade status of her records of $t-1$ (used to recompute `EXPOSED` under each reassigned rollout) |
| `ELIGIBLE_HISTORY` | `EXPOSURE_KNOWN` and not `EXPOSED`: her prior-year grades were earned before SAE reached the region and grade of her prior-year records (the sample of Appendix Table A1's last row) |

Names the notebook builds: a *cell* is a school-grade (`rbd|cod_nivel`), with an integer `cell_id`;
the cell-year panel holds `n_ent` (entrants), `n_gpa` (entrants with a prior-year GPA), `gpa_z`
(their mean prior-year GPA), `sh_prio` (the low-income share) and `w_ent` (the cell's mean `n_ent`,
the weight of the entrant-weighted row); `G = DOOR + 1` is the cell's adoption year $g$, the
academic year of the first class SAE assigns; a region's *wave* is the `DOOR` of its entry grades
(SAE reached a region's other grades a year later), and the rollout's four waves hold 1, 4, 10 and
1 regions.

## Setup

Loads the packages, checks the R and did versions, and sets the seeds, the draw counts and the
output folders. The random-number state is set from these seeds before each estimate, as in the run
of record (the run that produced the paper's exhibits).

```{r setup, error = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(did)
library(parallel)
library(tools)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = TRUE, error = FALSE)
if (!exists("params"))
  params <- local({
    home <- ifelse(Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE") != "", Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE"), path.expand("~"))
    data_dir <- file.path(home, "Dropbox", "Effect SAE on SUA", "data", "finalized_design_v1", "section2")
    list(panel_file = file.path(data_dir, "section2_panel.rds"), schedules_dir = file.path(data_dir, "draws", "did"),
         output_dir = "section2_output", cores = 0L)
  })
options(warn = 1)
say <- function(...) { message(sprintf(...)); invisible(NULL) }

# R 4.5.1 and did 2.1.2 are required
local({
  r_now <- paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = ".")
  bad <- c(if (r_now != "4.5.1") sprintf("R %s (required: 4.5.1)", r_now),
           if (as.character(packageVersion("did")) != "2.1.2")
             sprintf("did %s (required: 2.1.2)", packageVersion("did")))
  if (length(bad)) stop("this notebook needs R 4.5.1 and did 2.1.2: ", paste(bad, collapse = "; "), call. = FALSE)
})
say("R %s.%s; did %s; data.table %s; knitr %s", R.version$major, R.version$minor, packageVersion("did"),
    packageVersion("data.table"), packageVersion("knitr"))

# seeds and draw counts (RI, in names such as B_RI and ri_p, stands for randomization inference: the
# tests over the saved reassignments of the rollout)
SEED_MAIN <- 20260815       # Table 1, Appendix Table A2 and Figure 1's GPA panel
SEED_ROBUST <- 20260806     # Appendix Table A1, rows 2-5 (both columns restart it)
SEED_PRIO_ES <- 20260830    # Figure 1's low-income panel
SEED_PRIOR <- 20260915L     # Appendix Table A1, last row
B_BOOT <- 10000             # bootstrap draws: Table 1, Figure 1, Table A2, Table A1's last row
B_BOOT_ROBUST <- 999        # bootstrap draws: Table A1, rows 2-5
B_RI <- 9999L               # saved rollout reassignments: Table 1 and Table A1's last row
B_RI_ROBUST <- 2999L        # saved reassignments: Table A1 rows 2-5, Table A2, the joint lead tests
# the paired estimate the randomization test studentizes uses the cells observed in both years of
# each comparison; did also uses cells observed in one year. Each paired estimate must stay this
# close to did's (prior-year GPA in SD; low-income share as a proportion)
TRACK_TOL <- c(gpa_z = 0.02, sh_prio = 0.005)
# the paired leads g-6 .. g-2 (the joint lead test's statistic) must stay this close to did's dynamic leads
LEADS_TRACK_TOL <- 0.02
LEAD_LIMIT_SD <- 0.03       # the largest GPA lead is recorded against this size (gpa_leads_check.csv)

# folders: a relative path is read from this notebook's folder
NOTEBOOK_DIR <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/")
in_notebook_dir <- function(p) if (grepl("^([A-Za-z]:|/)", p)) p else file.path(NOTEBOOK_DIR, p)
output_dir <- normalizePath(in_notebook_dir(params$output_dir), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
TAB_DIR <- file.path(output_dir, "tables")
FIG_DIR <- file.path(output_dir, "figures")
OUT_DIR <- file.path(output_dir, "staggered_did")
PRIOR_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "prior_gpa")
AUDIT_DIR <- file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "child_audit")
BOOT_DIR <- file.path(output_dir, "draws", "bootstrap")
for (folder in c(TAB_DIR, FIG_DIR, OUT_DIR, PRIOR_DIR, AUDIT_DIR, BOOT_DIR))
  dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
CELL_PANEL_FILE <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "entrant_composition_panel.rds")

available_cores <- parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE)
if (is.na(available_cores)) available_cores <- 1L
N_CORES <- if (is.null(params$cores) || params$cores == 0L) available_cores else
  min(available_cores, as.integer(params$cores))
stopifnot(length(N_CORES) == 1L, is.finite(N_CORES), N_CORES >= 1L)
setDTthreads(N_CORES)
say("cores: %d found, %d used", available_cores, N_CORES)
```

## Computing resources

Defines how many worker processes the randomization tests use: as many as the cores allow and the
free memory holds. Each worker scores whole reassignments, and the scores are combined in the
reassignments' order.

```{r computing-resources}
# The memory free for worker processes, in bytes (NA when it cannot be read): on Windows the free
# physical memory; on Linux MemAvailable, bounded by the control group's limit (cgroup v2: memory.max
# less memory.current at every level of the group's path; cgroup v1: memory.limit_in_bytes less
# memory.usage_in_bytes); on macOS the free, inactive, speculative and purgeable pages
available_memory <- function() {
  read_number <- function(f) if (file.exists(f)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(readLines(f, warn = FALSE)[1L])) else NA_real_
  bytes <- tryCatch({
    os <- Sys.info()[["sysname"]]
    if (os == "Windows") {
      value <- system2("powershell.exe", c("-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command",
        shQuote("(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory * 1024")),
        stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE)
      as.numeric(tail(value, 1L))
    } else if (os == "Linux") {
      info <- readLines("/proc/meminfo", warn = FALSE)
      available <- as.numeric(sub("^MemAvailable:\\s*([0-9]+).*", "\\1",
        grep("^MemAvailable:", info, value = TRUE))) * 1024
      groups <- readLines("/proc/self/cgroup", warn = FALSE)
      v1 <- grep("^[0-9]+:([^:]+,)?memory(,[^:]+)?:", groups, value = TRUE)
      if (length(v1)) {
        base <- "/sys/fs/cgroup/memory"
        dirs <- unique(c(file.path(base, sub("^/", "", sub("^[^:]*:[^:]*:", "", v1[1L]))), base))
        limit <- vapply(file.path(dirs, "memory.limit_in_bytes"), read_number, 0)
        used <- vapply(file.path(dirs, "memory.usage_in_bytes"), read_number, 0)
        ok <- is.finite(limit) & is.finite(used) & limit < 2^60
        if (any(ok)) available <- min(available, max(0, limit[ok][1L] - used[ok][1L])) else
          message("cgroup v1: no memory limit could be read; using MemAvailable")
        return(available)
      }
      group <- grep("^0::", groups, value = TRUE)
      root <- "/sys/fs/cgroup"
      parts <- if (length(group)) strsplit(sub("^0::/?", "", group[1L]), "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]] else character(0)
      parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
      dirs <- c(root, if (length(parts)) file.path(root, Reduce(file.path, parts, accumulate = TRUE)))
      limit <- vapply(file.path(dirs, "memory.max"), read_number, 0)         # "max" (no limit) reads as NA
      used <- vapply(file.path(dirs, "memory.current"), read_number, 0)
      readable <- file.exists(file.path(dirs, "memory.max")) & file.exists(file.path(dirs, "memory.current"))
      if (length(group) && !any(readable)) return(NA_real_)
      ok <- is.finite(limit) & is.finite(used)
      if (any(ok)) available <- min(available, max(0, min(limit[ok] - used[ok])))
      available
    } else if (os == "Darwin") {
      info <- system2("/usr/bin/vm_stat", stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE)
      page <- as.numeric(sub(".*page size of ([0-9]+) bytes.*", "\\1", info[1L]))
      pages <- function(label) {
        x <- grep(paste0("^", label, ":"), info, value = TRUE)
        if (length(x)) as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", x[1L])) else 0
      }
      page * sum(vapply(c("Pages free", "Pages inactive", "Pages speculative", "Pages purgeable"), pages, 0))
    } else NA_real_
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  if (length(bytes) != 1L || !is.finite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) NA_real_ else bytes
}

# The number of worker processes for a set of tasks: at most `cores`, and as many as the free memory
# holds after a reserve of a quarter of it (at least 2 GB), given each task's estimated bytes; one
# worker when the free memory cannot be read. Prints the count and the reason
worker_limit <- function(bytes_per_task, cores, label) {
  n <- min(as.integer(cores), length(bytes_per_task))
  available <- available_memory()
  if (!is.finite(available)) {
    say("%s: the free memory could not be read; one worker process", label)
    return(1L)
  }
  budget <- max(0, available - max(2 * 1024^3, .25 * available))
  largest <- sort(bytes_per_task, decreasing = TRUE)
  while (n > 1L && sum(head(largest, n)) > budget) n <- n - 1L
  if (largest[1L] > budget) say("%s: one task's estimated memory exceeds the budget", label)
  say("%s: %d worker process%s (cores %d; free memory %.1f GB, budget %.1f GB, about %.2f GB a task)",
      label, n, if (n == 1L) "" else "es", as.integer(cores), available / 1024^3, budget / 1024^3, largest[1L] / 1024^3)
  n
}
```

## Saved schedules and bootstrap draws

Reads the 14 files of saved rollout reassignments (9,999 or 2,999 each) and checks that the R and
package versions equal those the draws were drawn with. Every randomization test of Table 1, Figure 1 and Appendix Tables A1 and
A2 scores its saved reassignments. The bootstrap draws are drawn anew and saved in
`section2_output/draws/bootstrap/`.

```{r saved-draws}
schedules_dir <- in_notebook_dir(params$schedules_dir)
SCHEDULES <- c(headline = "8fba99598b055af2420780f23eb437a2",
               gpa_robustness_2 = "c9787f96b13f289545dcbedd9e6d2063", gpa_robustness_3 = "cc1f2d7fc419f1d1ad20e7d7320d8755",
               gpa_robustness_4 = "464b1e06f3167adfed2c5c5940443535", gpa_robustness_5 = "14d412aca01afa701b4eca3a4cdbd443",
               prioritario_robustness_2 = "50178860510ed5712ebd54e8121a9357",
               prioritario_robustness_3 = "d3df74661b4854f97bcd650b79352d82",
               prioritario_robustness_4 = "e3fae3f52e7902f763a78b00266c91e2",
               prioritario_robustness_5 = "ed74a2de4087a98d5605de3fb017fa3f",
               pretrends_gpa_z = "d8458dada6abaff6d23c90ab3496e3ab", pretrends_sh_prio = "fcaf1037de00f4da8bd2c865ca765a9d",
               intake_count = "18d6e5bce437c6874ba43f408334c97d", intake_gpa_coverage = "c1582c9a654ba50abf95cf922cd06b51",
               prior_gpa = "9a6b78b0a82c594f1bdc07066cb8844b")
schedule_files <- file.path(schedules_dir, "regional", paste0(names(SCHEDULES), ".rds"))
if (!all(file.exists(schedule_files)))
  stop("missing: ", paste(schedule_files[!file.exists(schedule_files)], collapse = ", "))
schedule_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(schedule_files))
if (!identical(schedule_md5, unname(SCHEDULES)))
  stop("these files differ from the run of record: ", paste(basename(schedule_files)[schedule_md5 != SCHEDULES], collapse = ", "))
stopifnot("the bootstrap draws are drawn anew: their folder starts empty" = length(list.files(BOOT_DIR)) == 0L)

draw_packages <- c("did", "BMisc", "data.table", "DRDID", "Matrix", "Rcpp", "RcppArmadillo")
print(data.table(package = draw_packages,
                 version = vapply(draw_packages, function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p)), "")))

# The saved reassignments of one randomization test: B schedules, each giving the 16 regions the
# observed wave years in a random order (the waves keep their sizes 1, 4, 10 and 1). The saved
# observed waves must equal those computed from the panel. Returns the B schedules (region -> wave)
wave_draws <- function(id, waves, B) {
  stopifnot("a schedule file of record" = id %in% names(SCHEDULES))
  saved <- readRDS(file.path(schedules_dir, "regional", paste0(id, ".rds")))
  stopifnot("the schedule's observed waves are the panel's" = identical(saved$observed, waves),
            "the schedule holds B reassignments" = nrow(saved$assignments) == B,
            "one column per region" = identical(colnames(saved$assignments), names(waves)))
  lapply(seq_len(B), function(b) setNames(saved$assignments[b, ], names(waves)))
}

# Evaluates a did call while saving its bootstrap draws: did's internal run_multiplier_bootstrap is
# replaced, for the duration of the call, by a function that draws as did does, saves each draw
# (multipliers by region, deviations, random-number state) to draws/bootstrap/<label>_<call>.rds,
# and asserts that the saved multipliers reproduce did's deviations (to 1e-10) from the same
# random-number state; did's function is restored on exit
with_bootstrap_draws <- function(expr, label, regions) {
  prefix <- label
  call_state <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  call_state$n <- 0L
  namespace <- asNamespace("did")
  original_sampler <- get("run_multiplier_bootstrap", envir = namespace)
  sampler <- function(inf.func, biters, pl = FALSE, cores = 1) {
    call_state$n <- call_state$n + 1L
    filename <- file.path(BOOT_DIR, sprintf("%s_%02d.rds", prefix, call_state$n))
    if (file.exists(filename)) stop("The bootstrap draws are drawn anew; a saved file exists: ", filename)
    before <- .Random.seed
    deviations <- original_sampler(inf.func, biters, pl, cores)
    after <- .Random.seed
    assign(".Random.seed", before, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    n <- nrow(inf.func)
    multipliers <- BMisc::multiplier_bootstrap(diag(n), biters) * n
    stopifnot(identical(.Random.seed, after), n == length(regions),
              max(abs(deviations - multipliers %*% inf.func / n), na.rm = TRUE) < 1e-10)
    assign(".Random.seed", after, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    colnames(multipliers) <- as.character(regions)
    saveRDS(list(id = prefix, call = call_state$n, regions = regions, biters = biters,
                 influence = inf.func, multipliers = multipliers, deviations = deviations,
                 rng_before = before, rng_after = after), filename)
    deviations
  }
  unlockBinding("run_multiplier_bootstrap", namespace)
  assign("run_multiplier_bootstrap", sampler, envir = namespace)
  lockBinding("run_multiplier_bootstrap", namespace)
  on.exit({
    unlockBinding("run_multiplier_bootstrap", namespace)
    assign("run_multiplier_bootstrap", original_sampler, envir = namespace)
    lockBinding("run_multiplier_bootstrap", namespace)
  }, add = TRUE)
  eval(substitute(expr), envir = parent.frame())
}
```

## Inputs: Section 2's panel and the cell-year panel

Reads Section 2's panel and sums its rows into the cell-year panel every estimate reads: one row per
school-grade and year with its entrants, their mean prior-year GPA and their low-income share. The
prior-year GPA of PreKinder, Kinder and 1st-grade cell-years is left blank (the GPA outcome covers
entrants to grades 2-12). Writes `staggered_did/entrant_composition_panel.rds`.

```{r panel-inputs}
PANEL_FILE <- in_notebook_dir(params$panel_file)
if (!file.exists(PANEL_FILE)) stop("Section 2's panel is missing: ", PANEL_FILE)
PANEL_MD5 <- "3104b4b2b1b6998941311667fa0ab785"
if (!identical(unname(tools::md5sum(PANEL_FILE)), PANEL_MD5))
  stop("the panel is not Section 2's panel of record (MD5 ", PANEL_MD5, "): ", PANEL_FILE)
S2P <- as.data.table(readRDS(PANEL_FILE))
stopifnot("the panel's columns" = all(c("MRUN", "AGNO", "RBD", "COD_NIVEL", "REGION", "IS_ENTRY", "DOOR", "SLACK_FAIL",
                                        "DOOR_YEAR_TAG", "PRIO", "PRIOR_GPA_Z") %in% names(S2P)),
          "one row per child and year" = !anyDuplicated(S2P, by = c("MRUN", "AGNO")))
OUT <- S2P[, .(n_ent = .N, sh_prio = mean(PRIO), gpa_z = mean(PRIOR_GPA_Z, na.rm = TRUE), n_gpa = sum(!is.na(PRIOR_GPA_Z))),
           by = .(yr = AGNO, rbd = RBD, cod_nivel = COD_NIVEL, door = DOOR, region = REGION, is_entry = IS_ENTRY)]
TAGS <- unique(S2P[, .(rbd = RBD, cod_nivel = COD_NIVEL, slack_fail = SLACK_FAIL, door_year_tag = DOOR_YEAR_TAG)])
stopifnot("one pair of flags per cell" = !anyDuplicated(TAGS, by = c("rbd", "cod_nivel")))
OUT <- OUT[, .(rbd, cod_nivel, yr, region, is_entry, door, n_ent, n_gpa, gpa_z, sh_prio)]
OUT[cod_nivel == 1L, `:=`(gpa_z = NA_real_, n_gpa = 0L)]
OUT[cod_nivel %in% c(-1L, 0L), `:=`(gpa_z = NA_real_, n_gpa = 0L)]
OUT[TAGS, on = .(rbd, cod_nivel), `:=`(slack_fail = i.slack_fail, door_year_tag = i.door_year_tag)]
stopifnot("every cell-year found its cell's flags" = !anyNA(OUT$slack_fail) && !anyNA(OUT$door_year_tag))
setcolorder(OUT, c("rbd", "cod_nivel", "yr", "region", "is_entry", "door",
                   "n_ent", "n_gpa", "gpa_z", "sh_prio", "slack_fail", "door_year_tag"))
setattr(OUT, "index", NULL)
saveRDS(OUT, CELL_PANEL_FILE)
rm(TAGS)
N_CELLS <- 8891L                                       # the panel's school-grades
stopifnot("8,891 school-grades" = uniqueN(OUT[, .(rbd, cod_nivel)]) == N_CELLS)
say("panel: %s entrant child-years | %s cell-years | %s school-grades", format(nrow(S2P), big.mark = ","),
    format(nrow(OUT), big.mark = ","), format(N_CELLS, big.mark = ","))
```

## Estimators and the randomization statistic

Defines the estimators every exhibit uses. Each estimate is did's group-time average effect
(Callaway and Sant'Anna 2021) with not-yet-treated comparison cells, a universal base period ($g-1$),
no anticipation and an unbalanced panel, aggregated by did's `aggte`; its standard error comes from
did's multiplier bootstrap clustered by region. The significance stars come from randomization
inference: the paired estimate, studentized by its delete-one-region jackknife standard error, is
recomputed under each saved reassignment of the rollout across regions, and the p-value is the share
of reassignments whose statistic is at least as large in absolute value. The did fits run in one
separate R process; its warnings and messages are printed here. Each fit prints two warnings that
`BMisc::rhs.vars` and `BMisc::getListElement` are deprecated (36 in all): did 2.1.2 calls these two
renamed BMisc functions, and the run of record made the same calls.

```{r estimation-functions}
fmt  <- function(x) sub("^-(0\\.000)$", "\\1", sprintf("%.3f", x))
star <- function(p) ifelse(p < .01, "$^{***}$", ifelse(p < .05, "$^{**}$", ifelse(p < .1,  "$^{*}$", "")))
stars_text <- function(p) ifelse(p < .01, "***", ifelse(p < .05, "**", ifelse(p < .1, "*", "")))
row_tex <- function(lbl, vals) paste0("      ", lbl, " & ", paste(vals, collapse = " & "), "\\\\\n")

# did's overall effect of SAE on outcome `yvar` in the cell-year panel D (optionally weighted by
# column `weightsname`), with `bit` bootstrap draws; returns the estimate, its SE and the counts
fit_cs <- function(D, yvar, weightsname = NULL, bit = B_BOOT, id) {
  d <- D[!is.na(get(yvar)), c(.(cell_id = cell_id, yr = yr, G = G, region = region, y = get(yvar)),
                              if (!is.null(weightsname)) .(w = get(weightsname)))]
  estimate <- fit_did(d, id, weightsname = if (!is.null(weightsname)) "w", bit = bit)
  stopifnot("a finite estimate and standard error" = is.finite(estimate$att) && is.finite(estimate$se))
  list(att = estimate$att, se = estimate$se, n_cellyears = nrow(d), n_cells = uniqueN(d$cell_id))
}
# the outcome's mean over every cell-year before the cell's adoption year (the tables' "Mean (pre-treatment)")
pre_mean <- function(D, yvar) D[yr < G & !is.na(get(yvar)), mean(get(yvar))]

# each region's wave: the DOOR of its entry grades (DOOR - 1 at the other grades); one wave per region
wave_map <- function(D) {
  WM <- unique(D[, .(region, door, is_entry)])
  WM[, wave := door - (1L - is_entry)]
  stopifnot("one wave per region" = WM[, uniqueN(wave), by = region][, all(V1 == 1L)])
  W <- unique(WM[, .(region, wave)])[order(region)]
  setNames(W$wave, as.character(W$region))
}
# the outcome as a cell x year matrix, with each cell's region, entry status and (optionally) weight
prep_ri <- function(D, yvar, wcol = NULL) {
  d <- D[!is.na(get(yvar))]
  d <- d[, c("cell", "region", "is_entry", "yr", yvar, wcol), with = FALSE]
  setnames(d, yvar, "y")
  Wd <- dcast(d, cell + region + is_entry ~ yr, value.var = "y")
  yrs <- as.integer(setdiff(names(Wd), c("cell", "region", "is_entry")))
  w <- NULL
  if (!is.null(wcol)) {
    wc <- unique(d[, .(cell, wv = get(wcol))])
    w <- wc$wv[match(Wd$cell, wc$cell)]
    stopifnot("one weight per cell, none missing" = !anyDuplicated(wc$cell) && !anyNA(w))
  }
  list(M = as.matrix(Wd[, as.character(yrs), with = FALSE]),
       region = Wd$region, is_entry = Wd$is_entry, yrs = yrs, w = w)
}
ES_LEADS <- -6L:-2L
# The paired leads at g-6 .. g-2 under a rollout: for each adoption group g and lead e, the treated
# cells' mean change from g-1 to g+e less the not-yet-treated cells' mean change, using the cells
# observed in both years, averaged over groups by their treated-cell counts (the joint lead test's statistic)
paired_leads <- function(pp, wv) {
  G <- wv[as.character(pp$region)] + (1L - pp$is_entry) + 1L
  yrs <- pp$yrs; M <- pp$M
  out <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(ES_LEADS)), as.character(ES_LEADS))
  for (e in ES_LEADS) {
    num <- 0; den <- 0
    for (g in sort(unique(G))) {
      bi <- match(g - 1L, yrs); ti <- match(g + e, yrs)
      if (is.na(bi) || is.na(ti)) next
      tr <- G == g
      ok_t <- tr & !is.na(M[, ti]) & !is.na(M[, bi])
      ok_c <- (G > g - 1L) & !tr & !is.na(M[, ti]) & !is.na(M[, bi])
      if (!any(ok_t) || !any(ok_c)) next
      att <- mean(M[ok_t, ti] - M[ok_t, bi]) - mean(M[ok_c, ti] - M[ok_c, bi])
      num <- num + sum(ok_t) * att; den <- den + sum(ok_t)
    }
    out[as.character(e)] <- if (den > 0) num / den else NA_real_
  }
  out
}
# The joint randomization test of the leads g-6 .. g-2 (Figure 1): the observed paired leads, each
# divided by its SD across the saved reassignments; the statistic is the largest of the five in
# absolute value, and p is the share of reassignments whose largest is at least as large. Also counts
# the reassignments under which a lead could not be computed
ri_pretrend_y <- function(D, yvar, check = NULL, B = B_RI_ROBUST) {
  wv <- wave_map(D); pp <- prep_ri(D, yvar)
  obs <- paired_leads(pp, wv)
  if (!is.null(check))
    stopifnot("the paired leads track did's dynamic leads (within LEADS_TRACK_TOL)" =
                max(abs(obs[names(check)] - check), na.rm = TRUE) < LEADS_TRACK_TOL)
  WPS <- wave_draws(paste0("pretrends_", yvar), wv, B)
  P <- do.call(rbind, score_schedules(WPS, pp, paired_leads))
  sdp <- apply(P, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  fmax <- apply(abs(P) / rep(sdp, each = B), 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
  list(p = (1 + sum(fmax >= max(abs(obs) / sdp, na.rm = TRUE))) / (1 + length(fmax)),
       n_missing = sum(rowSums(is.na(P)) > 0L))
}

# The pieces of the paired estimate that do not depend on the rollout: for each adoption group g and
# year t >= g, the cells observed in t and g-1 and their change from g-1 to t
prepare_jackknife <- function(pp, waves) {
  region_index <- match(as.character(pp$region), names(waves))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(region_index))
  groups <- sort(unique(as.vector(outer(unname(waves), 1L - unique(pp$is_entry), `+`)) + 1L))
  pairs <- unlist(lapply(groups, function(g) {
    bi <- match(g - 1L, pp$yrs)
    if (is.na(bi)) return(list())
    lapply(pp$yrs[pp$yrs >= g], function(t) {
      ti <- match(t, pp$yrs)
      valid <- which(!is.na(pp$M[, ti]) & !is.na(pp$M[, bi]))
      list(g = g, t = t, rows = valid, difference = pp$M[valid, ti] - pp$M[valid, bi],
           region = pp$region[valid], weight = if (is.null(pp$w)) NULL else pp$w[valid])
    })
  }), recursive = FALSE)
  list(region_index = region_index, is_entry = pp$is_entry, pairs = pairs,
       regions = sort(unique(pp$region)))
}

# The randomization statistic under a rollout `waves`: th, the paired estimate (each group-time
# effect is the treated cells' mean change less the not-yet-treated cells' mean change, weighted by
# treated-cell counts, or by the cells' weights when given), and t, th divided by its
# delete-one-region jackknife standard error
score_jackknife <- function(prepared, waves) {
  G <- unname(waves)[prepared$region_index] + 2L - prepared$is_entry
  numerator <- denominator <- numeric(length(prepared$regions) + 1L)
  for (pair in prepared$pairs) {
    group <- G[pair$rows]
    treated <- which(group == pair$g)
    control <- which(group > pair$t)
    if (!length(treated) || !length(control)) next
    for (j in seq_along(numerator)) {
      it <- treated; ic <- control
      if (j > 1L) {
        omit <- prepared$regions[j - 1L]
        it <- it[pair$region[it] != omit]
        ic <- ic[pair$region[ic] != omit]
      }
      if (!length(it) || !length(ic)) next
      if (is.null(pair$weight)) {
        att <- mean(pair$difference[it]) - mean(pair$difference[ic])
        weight <- length(it)
      } else {
        att <- weighted.mean(pair$difference[it], pair$weight[it]) -
          weighted.mean(pair$difference[ic], pair$weight[ic])
        weight <- sum(pair$weight[it])
      }
      numerator[j] <- numerator[j] + weight * att
      denominator[j] <- denominator[j] + weight
    }
  }
  estimates <- rep(NA_real_, length(numerator))
  valid <- denominator != 0
  estimates[valid] <- numerator[valid] / denominator[valid]
  loo <- estimates[-1L]
  ok <- !is.na(loo); Rp <- sum(ok)
  variance <- if (Rp >= 2L) (Rp - 1) / Rp * sum((loo[ok] - mean(loo[ok]))^2) else NA_real_
  c(th = estimates[1L], t = estimates[1L] / sqrt(variance))
}

# scores a list of rollout schedules with `score`, in the worker processes when there are several
score_schedules <- function(schedules, prepared, score = score_jackknife) {
  if (is.null(cl)) return(lapply(schedules, function(w) score(prepared, w)))
  environment(score) <- .GlobalEnv
  clusterExport(cl, c("prepared", "score"), envir = environment())
  run <- function(w) score(prepared, w)
  environment(run) <- .GlobalEnv
  parLapplyLB(cl, schedules, run,
    chunk.size = max(1L, ceiling(length(schedules) / (4L * length(cl)))))
}

# The randomization test of one estimate: the observed statistic against its B saved reassignments
# `key`; p counts the reassignments whose |t| is at least the observed |t| (reassignments with an
# undefined statistic are dropped, at most 5%)
score_stream <- function(pp, wv, B, key) {
  prepared <- prepare_jackknife(pp, wv)
  obs <- score_jackknife(prepared, wv)
  WPS <- wave_draws(key, wv, B)
  RES <- do.call(rbind, score_schedules(WPS, prepared))
  TT <- RES[, "t"]
  p  <- (1 + sum(abs(TT[is.finite(TT)]) >= abs(obs["t"]))) / (1 + sum(is.finite(TT)))
  stopifnot("non-finite draws must stay under 5%" = mean(!is.finite(TT)) <= 0.05)
  list(th = unname(obs["th"]), t = unname(obs["t"]), p = p,
       n_dropped = sum(!is.finite(TT)))
}

# One did fit, run in the model process: att_gt, then aggte of `job$type`; did's warnings and
# messages are collected and returned with the result and the random-number state
bootstrap_model <- function(job) {
  assign(".Random.seed", job$rng, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  notes <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  notes$warnings <- character(0); notes$messages <- character(0)
  value <- withCallingHandlers(
    with_bootstrap_draws({
      fit <- do.call(did::att_gt, job$args)
      aggregate <- did::aggte(fit, type = job$type, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (job$keep_fit) list(fit = fit, aggregate = aggregate) else
        list(att = aggregate$overall.att, se = aggregate$overall.se)
    }, job$id, sort(unique(job$args$data$region))),
    warning = function(w) { notes$warnings <- c(notes$warnings, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") },
    message = function(m) { notes$messages <- c(notes$messages, conditionMessage(m)); invokeRestart("muffleMessage") })
  list(value = value, rng = .Random.seed, warnings = notes$warnings, messages = notes$messages)
}

# did on the data d (columns cell_id, yr, G, region, y): not-yet-treated comparisons, universal base
# period, no anticipation, unbalanced panel, multiplier bootstrap with `bit` draws clustered by region.
# The fit runs in the model process from this process's random-number state, which it then advances
fit_did <- function(d, id, type = "simple", weightsname = NULL, bit = B_BOOT, keep_fit = FALSE) {
  job <- list(id = id, type = type, keep_fit = keep_fit, rng = .Random.seed,
    args = list(yname = "y", tname = "yr", idname = "cell_id", gname = "G",
      data = d, control_group = "notyettreated", panel = TRUE,
      allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE, base_period = "universal",
      anticipation = 0L, weightsname = weightsname,
      bstrap = TRUE, biters = bit, clustervars = "region",
      print_details = FALSE))
  result <- tryCatch(clusterCall(model_worker, bootstrap_model, job)[[1L]],
    error = function(e) {
      try(stopCluster(model_worker), silent = TRUE)
      stop(e)
    })
  for (w in unique(result$warnings)) warning(sprintf("did (%s): %s", id, w), call. = FALSE)
  for (m in unique(result$messages)) message(sprintf("did (%s): %s", id, trimws(m)))
  assign(".Random.seed", result$rng, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  result$value
}

# the model process: one separate R process with data.table on one thread, where every did fit runs
model_worker <- makeCluster(1L)
initialize_model <- function(paths) {
  .libPaths(paths)
  library(data.table)
  library(did)
  data.table::setDTthreads(1L)
  NULL
}
environment(initialize_model) <- .GlobalEnv
tryCatch({
clusterCall(model_worker, initialize_model, .libPaths())
model_code <- list(with_bootstrap_draws = with_bootstrap_draws, BOOT_DIR = BOOT_DIR)
environment(model_code$with_bootstrap_draws) <- .GlobalEnv
environment(bootstrap_model) <- .GlobalEnv
clusterExport(model_worker, names(model_code), envir = list2env(model_code))
}, error = function(e) {
  try(stopCluster(model_worker), silent = TRUE)
  stop(e)
})
say("did fits: one model process")

main_workers <- worker_limit(rep(512 * 1024^2 + 4 * as.numeric(object.size(OUT)), N_CORES), N_CORES,
                             "randomization tests of Table 1, Figure 1 and Appendix Tables A1 and A2")
cl <- if (main_workers > 1L) makeCluster(main_workers) else NULL
if (!is.null(cl)) {
  clusterEvalQ(cl, { data.table::setDTthreads(1L); NULL })
  worker_code <- list(score_jackknife = score_jackknife, paired_leads = paired_leads, ES_LEADS = ES_LEADS)
  for (name in c("score_jackknife", "paired_leads"))
    environment(worker_code[[name]]) <- .GlobalEnv
  clusterExport(cl, names(worker_code), envir = list2env(worker_code))
}
```

## Analysis sample

Reads the cell-year panel and adds each cell's ID, its adoption year `G = DOOR + 1` and the weight
of the entrant-weighted row (`w_ent`, the cell's mean entrants). Checks that every cell has a region
and a door and that the regions fall in waves of 1, 4, 10 and 1. The cell IDs follow the R session's
collation order of the labels `rbd|cod_nivel` (the run of record: `English_United States.utf8` on
Windows); another collation orders the cells differently, which can move the last digits of the
estimates and standard errors.

```{r analysis-sample}
CP <- as.data.table(readRDS(CELL_PANEL_FILE))
CP[, cell := paste(rbd, cod_nivel, sep = "|")]
CP[, cell_id := as.integer(factor(cell))]
CP[, G := door + 1L]
CP[, w_ent := mean(n_ent), by = cell_id]
stopifnot("every cell must carry a region" = !anyNA(CP$region),
          "every cell must carry a treatment door" = !anyNA(CP$door))
wv_real <- wave_map(CP)
stopifnot("wave multiset must be {1,4,10,1}" =
            identical(as.integer(sort(as.vector(table(wv_real)))), c(1L, 1L, 4L, 10L)))
```

## Table 1: effects on the entering class

Estimates SAE's effect on entrants' mean prior-year GPA and on the low-income share (Table 1,
columns 1 and 2): did's estimate and bootstrap SE, and the randomization test over the 9,999 saved
reassignments `headline`. Writes `headline.rds` and `headline.csv`; the table itself is written in
the chunk "Writing Table 1 and Appendix Tables A1 and A2".

```{r composition-effects}
set.seed(SEED_MAIN)
g_reg <- fit_cs(CP, "gpa_z", id = "headline_gpa")
p_reg <- fit_cs(CP, "sh_prio", id = "headline_prio")

pp_g <- prep_ri(CP, "gpa_z")
pp_p <- prep_ri(CP, "sh_prio")
headline_prepared <- list(prepare_jackknife(pp_g, wv_real), prepare_jackknife(pp_p, wv_real))
obs_g <- score_jackknife(headline_prepared[[1L]], wv_real)
obs_p <- score_jackknife(headline_prepared[[2L]], wv_real)
stopifnot("the paired GPA estimate tracks did's" = abs(obs_g["th"] - g_reg$att) < TRACK_TOL[["gpa_z"]],
          "the paired low-income estimate tracks did's" = abs(obs_p["th"] - p_reg$att) < TRACK_TOL[["sh_prio"]])
WPS <- wave_draws("headline", wv_real, B_RI)
# both outcomes are scored under each reassignment: columns th and t of GPA, then of the low-income share
RES <- do.call(rbind, score_schedules(WPS, headline_prepared, function(prepared, w)
  c(score_jackknife(prepared[[1L]], w), score_jackknife(prepared[[2L]], w))))
stopifnot("no draw may be non-finite in the main randomization test" = all(is.finite(RES)))
p_g <- (1 + sum(abs(RES[, 2]) >= abs(obs_g["t"]))) / (1 + B_RI)
p_p <- (1 + sum(abs(RES[, 4]) >= abs(obs_p["t"]))) / (1 + B_RI)
cat(sprintf("Randomization test: GPA statistic %+.2f, p %.4f; low-income share statistic %+.2f, p %.4f.\n\n",
            obs_g["t"], p_g, obs_p["t"], p_p))

headline <- data.table(outcome = c("gpa_z", "sh_prio"), att = c(g_reg$att, p_reg$att),
                       se = c(g_reg$se, p_reg$se), p_ri = c(p_g, p_p),
                       pre_mean = c(pre_mean(CP, "gpa_z"), pre_mean(CP, "sh_prio")),
                       n_cellyears = c(g_reg$n_cellyears, p_reg$n_cellyears))
saveRDS(list(results = headline, fits = list(g_reg, p_reg),
             observed = list(obs_g, obs_p), draws = RES, assignments = WPS),
        file.path(OUT_DIR, "headline.rds"))
fwrite(headline, file.path(OUT_DIR, "headline.csv"))
print(headline)
```

## Appendix Table A1, prior-year GPA column: rows 1-5

Re-estimates the GPA effect with the Metropolitan Region dropped, without the cell-years with fewer
than five entrants with a prior-year GPA (the row "Thin cells excluded"), without the cells the slack
check flags, and with cells weighted by their entrants. Rows 2-5 have their own 999 bootstrap draws
and 2,999 saved reassignments; row 1 reports Table 1's fit and test. Row 1 is also fitted again with
999 draws and that fit is set aside: the run of record drew it, and rows 2-5 continue its
random-number stream. Writes `gpa_robustness.csv` with `robustness.rds` (next chunk).

```{r gpa-robustness}
set.seed(SEED_ROBUST)
specs <- list(
  list(lab = "Main estimate",               D = CP,                       w = NULL,    y = "gpa_z"),
  list(lab = "Metropolitan Region dropped", D = CP[region != 13L],        w = NULL,    y = "gpa_z"),
  list(lab = "Thin cells excluded",         D = CP[n_gpa >= 5L],          w = NULL,    y = "gpa_z"),
  list(lab = "Slack cells excluded",        D = CP[slack_fail == FALSE],  w = NULL,    y = "gpa_z"),
  list(lab = "Entrant-weighted",            D = CP,                       w = "w_ent", y = "gpa_z"))
fitb <- lapply(seq_along(specs), function(i) {
  s <- specs[[i]]
  fit_cs(s$D, s$y, weightsname = s$w, bit = B_BOOT_ROBUST, id = paste0("gpa_robustness_", i))
})
fitb[[1]] <- g_reg   # row 1 reports Table 1's fit
b_att <- vapply(fitb, `[[`, 0, "att"); b_se <- vapply(fitb, `[[`, 0, "se")
b_nobs <- vapply(fitb, `[[`, 0L, "n_cellyears")
b_pre  <- vapply(specs, function(s) pre_mean(s$D, s$y), 0)
b_p <- c(p_g, vapply(2:5, function(i) {
  s <- specs[[i]]
  score_stream(prep_ri(s$D, s$y, wcol = s$w), wave_map(s$D), B_RI_ROBUST, key = paste0("gpa_robustness_", i))$p
}, 0))
cat(sprintf("Randomization p by row: %s.\n\n", paste(sprintf("%.4f", b_p), collapse = ", ")))

gpa_robustness <- data.table(att = b_att, se = b_se, p_ri = b_p,
                            pre_mean = b_pre, n_cellyears = b_nobs)
print(cbind(row = vapply(specs, `[[`, "", "lab"), gpa_robustness))
```

## Appendix Table A1, low-income column: rows 1-5

The same five specifications for the low-income share; the row "Thin cells excluded" leaves out the
cell-years with fewer than five entrants. As in the GPA column, rows 2-5 have their own draws and
reassignments and row 1 reports Table 1's fit and test. Writes `prio_robustness_values.csv` (each
row's estimate, SE, the paired estimate, its studentized statistic and its randomization p) and
`robustness.rds`.

```{r prioritario-robustness}
t_prio <- proc.time()
set.seed(SEED_ROBUST)   # the low-income fits restart the seed of the GPA column
specs_p <- list(
  list(lab = "Main estimate",               D = CP,                       w = NULL,    y = "sh_prio"),
  list(lab = "Metropolitan Region dropped", D = CP[region != 13L],        w = NULL,    y = "sh_prio"),
  list(lab = "Thin cells excluded",         D = CP[n_ent >= 5L],          w = NULL,    y = "sh_prio"),
  list(lab = "Slack cells excluded",        D = CP[slack_fail == FALSE],  w = NULL,    y = "sh_prio"),
  list(lab = "Entrant-weighted",            D = CP,                       w = "w_ent", y = "sh_prio"))
fitp <- lapply(seq_along(specs_p), function(i) {
  s <- specs_p[[i]]
  fit_cs(s$D, s$y, weightsname = s$w, bit = B_BOOT_ROBUST, id = paste0("prioritario_robustness_", i))
})
fitp[[1]] <- p_reg   # row 1 reports Table 1's fit
q_att <- vapply(fitp, `[[`, 0, "att"); q_se <- vapply(fitp, `[[`, 0, "se")
q_nobs <- vapply(fitp, `[[`, 0L, "n_cellyears")
q_pre  <- vapply(specs_p, function(s) pre_mean(s$D, s$y), 0)
q_tests <- lapply(2:5, function(i) {
  s <- specs_p[[i]]
  score_stream(prep_ri(s$D, s$y, wcol = s$w), wave_map(s$D), B_RI_ROBUST, key = paste0("prioritario_robustness_", i))
})
q_p <- c(p_p, vapply(q_tests, `[[`, 0, "p"))
q_T <- c(unname(obs_p["t"]), vapply(q_tests, `[[`, 0, "t"))
q_drop <- c(0L, vapply(q_tests, `[[`, 0L, "n_dropped"))
q_paired <- c(unname(obs_p["th"]), vapply(q_tests, `[[`, 0, "th"))
say("Low-income share, randomization p by row: %s (%.1f min)",
    paste(sprintf("%.4f", q_p), collapse = ", "), (proc.time() - t_prio)[["elapsed"]] / 60)
say("Low-income share, paired estimate less did's, by row: %s (Table 1 asserts this within 0.005 at row 1 only)",
    paste(sprintf("%+.4f", q_paired - q_att), collapse = ", "))
resP <- data.table(column = vapply(specs_p, `[[`, "", "lab"), att = q_att, se = q_se,
                   pre_mean = q_pre, n_cellyears = q_nobs, paired_att = q_paired,
                   paired_minus_did = q_paired - q_att, T_stud = q_T, p_ri = q_p,
                   n_dropped = q_drop, draws = c(B_RI, rep(B_RI_ROBUST, 4L)))
print(resP)
fwrite(resP, file.path(OUT_DIR, "prio_robustness_values.csv"))

saveRDS(list(gpa = gpa_robustness, prioritario = resP,
             gpa_fits = fitb, prioritario_fits = fitp),
        file.path(OUT_DIR, "robustness.rds"))
fwrite(gpa_robustness, file.path(OUT_DIR, "gpa_robustness.csv"))
```

## Figure 1: event studies and the joint tests of the leads

Estimates the effect at each event time (did's dynamic aggregation) for both outcomes, draws
Figure 1's two panels from $g-6$ to $g+1$ with pointwise 95% intervals (estimate $\pm$ 1.96 SE), and
runs the joint randomization test of the five leads $g-6$ to $g-2$ over 2,999 saved reassignments.
Writes `figures/alloc_event_study.pdf`, `figures/alloc_event_study_prio.pdf`, `event_studies.rds` and
`gpa_leads_check.csv` (the five GPA leads and whether the largest is under 0.03 SD).

```{r event-studies}
# did's dynamic aggregation of one outcome, its plot (g-6 to g+1, the reference g-1 drawn at zero)
# and its leads g-6 .. g-2
es_one <- function(D, yvar, ylab, fname, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  d <- D[!is.na(get(yvar)), .(cell_id, yr, G, region, y = get(yvar))]
  estimate <- fit_did(d, paste0("event_study_", yvar), type = "dynamic", keep_fit = TRUE)
  at <- estimate$fit
  ed <- estimate$aggregate
  es <- data.table(e = ed$egt, att = ed$att.egt, se = ed$se.egt)
  print(es[is.finite(att), .(e, att = round(att, 4), se = round(se, 4))])
  leads_did <- es[e %in% -6:-2, setNames(att, as.character(e))]
  es <- es[e >= -6 & e <= 1 & is.finite(att) & is.finite(se)]
  stopifnot("every event time from g-6 to g+1 but the reference g-1 is estimated" =
              identical(as.integer(es$e), c(-6:-2, 0:1)))
  lo <- es$att - 1.96 * es$se; hi <- es$att + 1.96 * es$se
  pdf(fname, width = 7.2, height = 4.8, family = "serif")
  par(mar = c(4.6, 5.0, 1.2, 1.2), las = 1, mgp = c(3.1, 0.8, 0),
      cex.axis = 1.05, cex.lab = 1.2)
  plot(es$e, es$att, type = "n",
       ylim = range(pretty(c(lo, hi))), xlim = c(min(es$e) - 0.4, max(es$e) + 0.4),
       xlab = "Event time (years relative to SAE adoption)", ylab = ylab, xaxt = "n")
  axis(1, at = min(es$e):max(es$e))
  abline(h = 0, col = "black", lwd = 1)
  abline(v = -0.5, col = "black", lty = 2)
  arrows(es$e, lo, es$e, hi, length = 0.045, angle = 90, code = 3, col = "black", lwd = 1.3)
  points(es$e, es$att, pch = 21, bg = "white", col = "black", cex = 1.25, lwd = 1.4)
  points(-1, 0, pch = 21, bg = "white", col = "black", cex = 1.25, lwd = 1.4)
  invisible(dev.off())
  list(leads = leads_did, fit = at, dynamic = ed)
}
j_g <- es_one(CP, "gpa_z", "Effect on entrant prior-GPA (z)",
              file.path(FIG_DIR, "alloc_event_study.pdf"), SEED_MAIN)
rp_g <- ri_pretrend_y(CP, "gpa_z", check = j_g$leads)
cat(sprintf("Figure 1, GPA panel: joint randomization test of the leads g-6 to g-2, p = %.2f (reassignments with a lead not computed: %d).\n\n",
            rp_g$p, rp_g$n_missing))
j_p <- es_one(CP, "sh_prio", "Effect on low-income share",
              file.path(FIG_DIR, "alloc_event_study_prio.pdf"), SEED_PRIO_ES)
rp_p <- ri_pretrend_y(CP, "sh_prio", check = j_p$leads)
cat(sprintf("Figure 1, low-income panel: joint randomization test of the leads g-6 to g-2, p = %.2f (reassignments with a lead not computed: %d).\n\n",
            rp_p$p, rp_p$n_missing))
# the GPA leads, recorded: each lead, the largest in absolute value, and whether it is under 0.03 SD
lead_max <- max(abs(j_g$leads), na.rm = TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(lead = names(j_g$leads), estimate = unname(j_g$leads), largest_abs_lead = lead_max,
                  under_0_03_sd = lead_max < LEAD_LIMIT_SD),
       file.path(OUT_DIR, "gpa_leads_check.csv"))
say("GPA leads: %s; largest in absolute value %.4f SD; under 0.03 SD: %s",
    paste(sprintf("%s %+.4f", names(j_g$leads), j_g$leads), collapse = ", "), lead_max, lead_max < LEAD_LIMIT_SD)
saveRDS(list(gpa = j_g, prioritario = j_p, joint_p = c(rp_g$p, rp_p$p),
             joint_p_reassignments_with_lead_not_computed = c(rp_g$n_missing, rp_p$n_missing)),
        file.path(OUT_DIR, "event_studies.rds"))
```

## Appendix Table A2: intake and GPA coverage

Estimates SAE's effect on the number of entrants per cell and on the share of entrants with a
prior-year GPA (grades 2-12), each with 2,999 saved reassignments. Writes `intake_checks.rds` and
`intake_checks.csv`.

```{r intake-coverage}
CP[, sh_gpa := fifelse(n_ent > 0L, n_gpa / n_ent, NA_real_)]
CPg <- CP[cod_nivel >= 2L]
set.seed(SEED_MAIN)
g_ent <- fit_cs(CP, "n_ent", id = "intake_n_ent")
g_cov <- fit_cs(CPg, "sh_gpa", id = "intake_sh_gpa")
z_ent <- score_stream(prep_ri(CP,  "n_ent"),  wave_map(CP),  B_RI_ROBUST, key = "intake_count")
z_cov <- score_stream(prep_ri(CPg, "sh_gpa"), wave_map(CPg), B_RI_ROBUST, key = "intake_gpa_coverage")

intake_checks <- data.table(outcome = c("n_ent", "sh_gpa"), att = c(g_ent$att, g_cov$att),
                            se = c(g_ent$se, g_cov$se), p_ri = c(z_ent$p, z_cov$p),
                            pre_mean = c(pre_mean(CP, "n_ent"), pre_mean(CPg, "sh_gpa")),
                            n_cellyears = c(g_ent$n_cellyears, g_cov$n_cellyears))
saveRDS(list(results = intake_checks, fits = list(g_ent, g_cov),
             tests = list(z_ent, z_cov)), file.path(OUT_DIR, "intake_checks.rds"))
fwrite(intake_checks, file.path(OUT_DIR, "intake_checks.csv"))
if (!is.null(cl)) stopCluster(cl)
print(intake_checks)
```

## Appendix Table A1, last row: the sample of prior grades earned before SAE coverage

Builds the restricted cell-year panel of Table A1's last row: the entrants to grades 2-12 with a
prior-year GPA whose prior-year grades were all earned before SAE reached the region and grade of
her prior-year records (`ELIGIBLE_HISTORY`). Checks first that summing every entrant reproduces the cell-year panel. Also
writes the pieces the randomization test needs to recompute the restricted outcomes under each
reassigned rollout (`exposure_components.rds`: each cell-year's entrants grouped by the regions and
entry-grade status of their prior records), the restricted panel (`restricted_panel.rds`), the
sample's flow by reason and year (`sample_flow.csv`), its counts by year, grade, door and region,
and one audit file of entrants per year (`child_audit/`).

```{r prior-gpa-sample}
years <- 2012L:2023L
started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
save_output <- function(object, filename) saveRDS(object, file.path(PRIOR_DIR, filename))
assert_columns <- function(d, required, label) {
  absent <- setdiff(required, names(d))
  if (length(absent)) stop(label, " missing fields: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
}

# the inputs: Section 2's panel and the cell-year panel summed from it above
all_inputs <- c(section2_panel = PANEL_FILE, entrant_composition_panel.rds = CELL_PANEL_FILE)
input_hashes <- data.table(
  filename = names(all_inputs),
  path = unname(all_inputs),
  bytes = as.numeric(file.info(all_inputs)$size),
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(all_inputs))
)
save_output(input_hashes, "input_hashes.rds")
fwrite(input_hashes, file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "input_hashes.csv"))
cell_year_panel <- as.data.table(readRDS(CELL_PANEL_FILE))
panel_keys <- c("rbd", "cod_nivel", "yr")
cell_columns <- c("rbd", "cod_nivel", "region", "is_entry", "door",
                  "slack_fail", "door_year_tag")
assert_columns(cell_year_panel, c(cell_columns, "yr", "n_ent", "n_gpa", "gpa_z", "sh_prio"),
               "the cell-year panel")
if (anyDuplicated(cell_year_panel, by = panel_keys)) stop("the cell-year panel has duplicate cell-years")
cells_all <- unique(cell_year_panel[, ..cell_columns])
if (anyDuplicated(cells_all, by = c("rbd", "cod_nivel"))) {
  stop("a cell's fields vary across years")
}
if (nrow(cells_all) != N_CELLS) stop("the panel does not hold 8,891 school-grades")
child_fields <- c("PRIOR_GPA_Z", "N_PRIOR_RECORDS", "UNKNOWN_SCHOOL", "UNKNOWN_REGION", "UNKNOWN_GRADE",
                  "UNKNOWN_CALENDAR", "EXPOSURE_KNOWN", "EXPOSED", "SIGNATURE", "ELIGIBLE_HISTORY")
assert_columns(S2P, c("MRUN", "AGNO", "RBD", "COD_NIVEL", "PRIO", child_fields), "Section 2's panel")

# each region's wave: the door of its entry grades, one year earlier than the door of its other grades
wave_rows <- unique(cells_all[, .(region, wave = door - (1L - is_entry))])[order(region)]
if (anyDuplicated(wave_rows$region)) stop("a region has more than one wave")
if (nrow(wave_rows) != 16L) stop("the rollout must cover the 16 regions")
region_waves <- setNames(as.integer(wave_rows$wave), as.character(wave_rows$region))

cells <- copy(cells_all[cod_nivel >= 2L & cod_nivel <= 12L])
setorder(cells, rbd, cod_nivel)
cells[, cell_id := .I]
cell_years <- merge(cell_year_panel[, .(rbd, cod_nivel, yr)],
                    cells[, .(rbd, cod_nivel, cell_id)], by = c("rbd", "cod_nivel"))
setorder(cell_years, cell_id, yr)
cell_years[, cell_year_id := .I]
cell_years <- cell_years[, .(cell_year_id, cell_id, yr)]

say("Entrants and their prior-year record fields, from Section 2's panel")
per_year <- function() setNames(vector("list", length(years)), as.character(years))
rebuilt_years <- per_year(); restricted_years <- per_year(); component_years <- per_year()
flow_years <- per_year(); group_years <- per_year()

for (yr_value in years) {
  key <- as.character(yr_value)
  census_data <- S2P[AGNO == yr_value, .(mrun = as.character(MRUN), rbd = RBD, cod_nivel = COD_NIVEL)]
  prio_set <- S2P[AGNO == yr_value & PRIO == 1L, as.character(MRUN)]
  children <- S2P[AGNO == yr_value & !is.na(N_PRIOR_RECORDS), .(
    mrun = as.character(MRUN), z = PRIOR_GPA_Z, n_prior_records = N_PRIOR_RECORDS, unknown_school = UNKNOWN_SCHOOL,
    unknown_region = UNKNOWN_REGION, unknown_grade = UNKNOWN_GRADE, unknown_calendar = UNKNOWN_CALENDAR,
    exposure_known = EXPOSURE_KNOWN, exposed = EXPOSED, signature = SIGNATURE, eligible_history = ELIGIBLE_HISTORY)]
  entrants <- merge(census_data, cells_all, by = c("rbd", "cod_nivel"))
  if (nrow(entrants) != nrow(census_data)) stop("every entrant's cell must be one of the panel's cells")
  entrants[, `:=`(yr = yr_value, prio = as.integer(mrun %chin% prio_set))]
  n_entrants <- nrow(entrants)
  entrants <- merge(entrants, children, by = "mrun", all.x = TRUE)
  if (nrow(entrants) != n_entrants) stop("the prior-record join must keep one row per entrant")
  if (anyDuplicated(entrants, by = c("mrun", "rbd", "cod_nivel"))) {
    stop("an entrant appears twice in one cell and year")
  }
  entrants[, `:=`(
    valid_prior_gpa = !is.na(z),
    receiving_grade_eligible = cod_nivel >= 2L & cod_nivel <= 12L
  )]
  entrants[, eligible := receiving_grade_eligible & valid_prior_gpa &
                           !is.na(eligible_history) & eligible_history]
  entrants[, exclusion_reason := fcase(
    !receiving_grade_eligible, "receiving grade outside 2-12",
    !valid_prior_gpa, "no valid previous-year GPA",
    !exposure_known, "unknown sending exposure",
    exposed, "previous GPA includes SAE-covered schooling",
    default = "retained"
  )]
  rebuilt_years[[key]] <- entrants[, .(
    n_ent = .N, n_gpa = sum(!is.na(z)),
    gpa_z = mean(z, na.rm = TRUE), sh_prio = mean(prio)
  ), by = c(cell_columns, "yr")]
  restricted_years[[key]] <- entrants[eligible == TRUE, .(
    n_ent = .N, n_gpa = .N, gpa_z = mean(z), sh_prio = mean(prio)
  ), by = c(cell_columns, "yr")]
  comp <- entrants[receiving_grade_eligible & valid_prior_gpa & exposure_known, .(
    n = .N, sum_z = sum(z), sum_prio = sum(prio)
  ), by = .(rbd, cod_nivel, yr, signature)]
  comp <- merge(comp, cells[, .(rbd, cod_nivel, cell_id)], by = c("rbd", "cod_nivel"))
  comp <- merge(comp, cell_years, by = c("cell_id", "yr"))
  component_years[[key]] <- comp[, .(
    cell_year_id, signature, n, sum_z, sum_prio
  )]
  flow_years[[key]] <- entrants[, .(
    n = .N, distinct_pupils = uniqueN(mrun)
  ), by = .(yr, exclusion_reason)]
  group_years[[key]] <- entrants[, .(
    all_entrants = .N, valid_prior_gpa = sum(valid_prior_gpa),
    known_exposure = sum(exposure_known %in% TRUE), retained = sum(eligible),
    multiple_gpa_records = sum(n_prior_records > 1L, na.rm = TRUE),
    unknown_school = sum(unknown_school %in% TRUE),
    unknown_region = sum(unknown_region %in% TRUE),
    unknown_grade = sum(unknown_grade %in% TRUE),
    unknown_calendar = sum(unknown_calendar %in% TRUE)
  ), by = .(yr, cod_nivel, door, region)]
  saveRDS(entrants, file.path(AUDIT_DIR, sprintf("entrants_%d.rds", yr_value)))
  say("Year %d | entrants %s | retained %s | %.1f min", yr_value, format(nrow(entrants), big.mark = ","),
      format(entrants[eligible == TRUE, .N], big.mark = ","), (proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started) / 60)
  rm(census_data, prio_set, children, entrants, comp)
  invisible(gc())
}

# every entrant summed by cell-year reproduces the cell-year panel
rebuilt <- rbindlist(rebuilt_years)
rebuilt[cod_nivel == 1L, `:=`(gpa_z = NA_real_, n_gpa = 0L)]
rebuilt[cod_nivel %in% c(-1L, 0L), `:=`(gpa_z = NA_real_, n_gpa = 0L)]   # as the chunk panel-inputs blanks them
setcolorder(rebuilt, names(cell_year_panel))
setorderv(rebuilt, panel_keys)
setorderv(cell_year_panel, panel_keys)
save_output(rebuilt, "unrestricted_rebuilt.rds")
same_keys <- identical(as.data.frame(rebuilt[, ..panel_keys]),
                       as.data.frame(cell_year_panel[, ..panel_keys]))
value_checks <- if (!same_keys) list() else lapply(setdiff(names(cell_year_panel), panel_keys), function(v) {
  x <- rebuilt[[v]]
  y <- cell_year_panel[[v]]
  same_missing <- identical(is.na(x), is.na(y))
  finite_both <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  max_difference <- if (any(finite_both)) max(abs(x[finite_both] - y[finite_both])) else 0
  tolerance <- if (v %in% c("gpa_z", "sh_prio")) 1e-10 else 0
  data.table(check = paste0("same_", v),
             passed = same_missing && is.finite(max_difference) && max_difference <= tolerance,
             max_difference = max_difference)
})
reconciliation <- rbindlist(c(list(data.table(check = "same_cell_year_keys", passed = same_keys, max_difference = NA_real_)),
                              value_checks))
save_output(reconciliation, "unrestricted_reconciliation.rds")
fwrite(reconciliation, file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "unrestricted_reconciliation.csv"))
if (!all(reconciliation$passed)) stop("the entrants summed by cell-year differ from the cell-year panel; see unrestricted_reconciliation.csv")

restricted <- rbindlist(restricted_years)
setcolorder(restricted, names(cell_year_panel))
setorderv(restricted, panel_keys)
components <- rbindlist(component_years)
signature_keys <- data.table(signature = sort(unique(components$signature), method = "radix"))
signature_keys[, signature_id := .I]
components <- merge(components, signature_keys, by = "signature")
components <- components[, .(cell_year_id, signature_id, n, sum_z, sum_prio)]
setorder(components, cell_year_id, signature_id)
signatures <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(signature_keys)), function(i) {
  parts <- strsplit(signature_keys$signature[[i]], "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  parsed <- tstrsplit(parts, ":", fixed = TRUE)
  data.table(signature_id = i, sending_region = as.integer(parsed[[1L]]),
             is_entry = as.integer(parsed[[2L]]))
}))
exposure_components <- list(
  cells = cells, cell_years = cell_years, signatures = signatures,
  components = components, waves = region_waves
)
save_output(exposure_components, "exposure_components.rds")
save_output(signature_keys, "signature_dictionary.rds")
save_output(restricted, "restricted_panel.rds")
sample_flow <- rbindlist(flow_years)
group_counts <- rbindlist(group_years)
stopifnot("the restricted sample keeps some entrants and leaves some out" =
            sum(group_counts$retained) > 0L && sum(group_counts$retained) < sum(group_counts$all_entrants))
save_output(sample_flow, "sample_flow.rds")
save_output(group_counts, "sample_counts_by_year_grade_door_region.rds")
fwrite(sample_flow, file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "sample_flow.csv"))
fwrite(group_counts, file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "sample_counts_by_year_grade_door_region.csv"))
save_output(list(
  completed_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
  elapsed_seconds = proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started,
  cell_years = nrow(cell_year_panel), restricted_cell_years = nrow(restricted),
  entrant_cell_years = sum(cell_year_panel$n_ent),
  retained_entrant_cell_years = sum(restricted$n_ent),
  n_signatures = nrow(signature_keys), n_components = nrow(components),
  source_hashes = input_hashes, reconciliation = reconciliation, session_info = sessionInfo()
), "build_checks.rds")
say("Restricted sample: %s entrant child-years in %s cell-years; the entrants summed reproduce the cell-year panel",
    format(sum(restricted$n_ent), big.mark = ","), format(nrow(restricted), big.mark = ","))
rm(S2P)
invisible(gc())
```

## Appendix Table A1, last row: the estimators of the restricted sample

Defines did's estimate on the restricted panel and the randomization statistic, which rebuilds the
restricted outcomes under each reassigned rollout (an entrant's prior-year grades count as earned
before SAE coverage when, under that rollout, SAE reached every region and grade group of her
prior-year records after the year she earned them).

```{r prior-gpa-functions}
# did's overall effect on the restricted panel, with n_boot bootstrap draws; returns the estimate, SE,
# counts, the pre-adoption mean, the data, the fit and its aggregation
estimate_cs <- function(data, outcome, n_boot) {
  stopifnot(is.data.table(data), outcome %in% c("gpa_z", "sh_prio"),
            is.integer(n_boot), n_boot > 0L)
  d <- data[!is.na(get(outcome)), .(cell_id, yr, G, region, y = get(outcome))]
  stopifnot(nrow(d) > 0L, !anyDuplicated(d[, .(cell_id, yr)]),
            all(is.finite(d$y)), !anyNA(d))
  estimate <- fit_did(d, paste0("prior_gpa_", outcome), bit = n_boot, keep_fit = TRUE)
  fit <- estimate$fit
  aggregate <- estimate$aggregate
  stopifnot(is.finite(aggregate$overall.att), is.finite(aggregate$overall.se))
  list(estimate = aggregate$overall.att, se = aggregate$overall.se,
       n_obs = nrow(d), n_cells = uniqueN(d$cell_id), n_regions = uniqueN(d$region),
       pre_mean = d[yr < G, mean(y)], input = d, fit = fit, aggregate = aggregate)
}

# the pieces the rebuild under a rollout needs, checked: cells, cell-years, the signatures (regions
# and entry-grade status of the prior records) and each cell-year's entrants grouped by signature
prepare_exposure_context <- function(data) {
  required <- c("cells", "cell_years", "signatures", "components")
  stopifnot(all(required %in% names(data)))
  cells <- as.data.table(copy(data$cells))[order(cell_id)]
  years <- as.data.table(copy(data$cell_years))[order(cell_year_id)]
  signatures <- as.data.table(copy(data$signatures))
  components <- as.data.table(copy(data$components))
  stopifnot(identical(cells$cell_id, seq_len(nrow(cells))),
            identical(years$cell_year_id, seq_len(nrow(years))),
            !anyDuplicated(years[, .(cell_id, yr)]),
            !anyNA(signatures[, .(signature_id, sending_region, is_entry)]),
            all(components$n > 0L),
            all(is.finite(components$sum_z)), all(is.finite(components$sum_prio)))
  regions <- sort(unique(cells$region))
  stopifnot(length(regions) == 16L,
            all(signatures$sending_region %in% regions),
            all(signatures$is_entry %in% c(0L, 1L)))
  waves_dt <- unique(cells[, .(region, wave = door - (1L - is_entry))])
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(waves_dt$region))
  stopifnot(all(waves_dt$wave %in% 2016L:2019L))
  waves <- setNames(as.integer(waves_dt$wave[match(regions, waves_dt$region)]), as.character(regions))
  stopifnot(identical(as.integer(sort(as.vector(table(waves)))), c(1L, 1L, 4L, 10L)))
  n_signatures <- max(signatures$signature_id)
  stopifnot(identical(sort(unique(signatures$signature_id)), seq_len(n_signatures)),
            all(components$signature_id %in% signatures$signature_id),
            all(components$cell_year_id %in% years$cell_year_id))
  yr_values <- sort(unique(years$yr))
  matrix_index <- years$cell_id + (match(years$yr, yr_values) - 1L) * nrow(cells)
  sig_members <- split(seq_len(nrow(signatures)), signatures$signature_id)
  signature_columns <- lapply(seq_len(max(lengths(sig_members))), function(j)
    vapply(sig_members, function(ix) ix[min(j, length(ix))], integer(1L)))
  list(cells = cells, cell_years = years, components = components,
       signature_region_index = match(signatures$sending_region, regions),
       signature_offset = as.integer(2L - signatures$is_entry),
       signature_columns = signature_columns,
       component_year = years$yr[components$cell_year_id],
       component_values = as.matrix(components[, .(n, sum_z, sum_prio)]),
       n_signatures = n_signatures, waves = waves, regions = regions,
       region_index = match(cells$region, regions), years = yr_values,
       matrix_index = matrix_index)
}

# the restricted outcomes under a rollout `waves`: a group of entrants counts when its cell-year comes
# no later than the first academic year SAE covered any of its sending regions and grades; returns the
# GPA and low-income matrices (cell x year) and each cell-year's count
rebuild_exposure_outcomes <- function(context, waves) {
  stopifnot(identical(names(waves), as.character(context$regions)), !anyNA(waves))
  member_first <- unname(waves)[context$signature_region_index] + context$signature_offset
  first_academic <- do.call(pmin, lapply(context$signature_columns, function(ix) member_first[ix]))
  eligible <- context$component_year <= first_academic[context$components$signature_id]
  totals <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(context$cell_years), ncol = 3L)
  if (any(eligible)) {
    sums <- rowsum(context$component_values[eligible, , drop = FALSE],
                   context$components$cell_year_id[eligible], reorder = FALSE)
    totals[as.integer(rownames(sums)), ] <- sums
  }
  n <- totals[, 1L]
  gpa <- prio <- rep(NA_real_, length(n))
  observed <- n > 0L
  gpa[observed] <- totals[observed, 2L] / n[observed]
  prio[observed] <- totals[observed, 3L] / n[observed]
  M_gpa <- M_prio <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(context$cells), ncol = length(context$years))
  M_gpa[context$matrix_index] <- gpa
  M_prio[context$matrix_index] <- prio
  list(gpa_z = M_gpa, sh_prio = M_prio, n_eligible = n)
}

# the paired estimate written out group by group (the reference the fast version is checked against)
simple_att_literal <- function(data, adoption, years) {
  stopifnot(is.matrix(data), nrow(data) == length(adoption))
  numerator <- 0
  denominator <- 0
  for (g in sort(unique(adoption))) {
    baseline <- match(g - 1L, years)
    if (is.na(baseline)) next
    treated <- adoption == g
    for (t in years[years >= g]) {
      current <- match(t, years)
      ok_t <- treated & !is.na(data[, current]) & !is.na(data[, baseline])
      ok_c <- adoption > t & !is.na(data[, current]) & !is.na(data[, baseline])
      if (!any(ok_t) || !any(ok_c)) next
      att <- mean(data[ok_t, current] - data[ok_t, baseline]) -
        mean(data[ok_c, current] - data[ok_c, baseline])
      weight <- sum(ok_t)
      numerator <- numerator + weight * att
      denominator <- denominator + weight
    }
  }
  if (denominator <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  numerator / denominator
}

# the paired estimate, its studentized statistic and the delete-one-region estimates, written out
jackknife_literal <- function(data, adoption, years, region, regions) {
  att <- simple_att_literal(data, adoption, years)
  loo <- vapply(regions, function(r) {
    keep <- region != r
    simple_att_literal(data[keep, , drop = FALSE], adoption[keep], years)
  }, numeric(1L))
  ok <- !is.na(loo)
  n_valid <- sum(ok)
  variance <- if (n_valid >= 2L) {
    (n_valid - 1L) / n_valid * sum((loo[ok] - mean(loo[ok]))^2)
  } else NA_real_
  c(att = att, statistic = att / sqrt(variance), jk_se = sqrt(variance),
    n_valid_loo = n_valid, setNames(loo, paste0("loo_", regions)))
}

# the same as jackknife_literal, computed with region sums (every delete-one-region estimate in one pass)
jackknife_fast <- function(data, adoption, years, region_index, regions) {
  n_regions <- length(regions)
  numerator <- denominator <- numeric(n_regions + 1L)
  for (g in sort(unique(adoption))) {
    baseline <- match(g - 1L, years)
    if (is.na(baseline)) next
    for (t in years[years >= g]) {
      current <- match(t, years)
      difference <- data[, current] - data[, baseline]
      ok <- !is.na(difference)
      treated <- ok & adoption == g
      control <- ok & adoption > t
      if (!any(treated) || !any(control)) next
      counts_t <- tabulate(region_index[treated], nbins = n_regions)
      counts_c <- tabulate(region_index[control], nbins = n_regions)
      sums <- matrix(0, nrow = n_regions, ncol = 2L)
      st <- rowsum(difference[treated], region_index[treated], reorder = FALSE)
      sc <- rowsum(difference[control], region_index[control], reorder = FALSE)
      sums[as.integer(rownames(st)), 1L] <- st[, 1L]
      sums[as.integer(rownames(sc)), 2L] <- sc[, 1L]
      nt <- sum(counts_t) - c(0L, counts_t)
      nc <- sum(counts_c) - c(0L, counts_c)
      sum_t <- sum(sums[, 1L]) - c(0, sums[, 1L])
      sum_c <- sum(sums[, 2L]) - c(0, sums[, 2L])
      valid <- nt > 0L & nc > 0L
      numerator[valid] <- numerator[valid] + sum_t[valid] - nt[valid] * sum_c[valid] / nc[valid]
      denominator[valid] <- denominator[valid] + nt[valid]
    }
  }
  estimates <- rep(NA_real_, n_regions + 1L)
  estimates[denominator > 0] <- numerator[denominator > 0] / denominator[denominator > 0]
  att <- estimates[1L]
  loo <- estimates[-1L]
  ok <- !is.na(loo)
  n_valid <- sum(ok)
  variance <- if (n_valid >= 2L) {
    (n_valid - 1L) / n_valid * sum((loo[ok] - mean(loo[ok]))^2)
  } else NA_real_
  c(att = att, statistic = att / sqrt(variance), jk_se = sqrt(variance),
    n_valid_loo = n_valid, setNames(loo, paste0("loo_", regions)))
}

# both restricted outcomes' statistics under one rollout
score_exposure_map <- function(waves, context) {
  outcomes <- rebuild_exposure_outcomes(context, waves)
  adoption <- unname(waves)[context$region_index] + 2L - context$cells$is_entry
  result <- lapply(c("gpa_z", "sh_prio"), function(outcome) {
    value <- jackknife_fast(outcomes[[outcome]], adoption, context$years,
                            context$region_index, context$regions)
    setNames(value, paste0(outcome, "__", names(value)))
  })
  unlist(result, use.names = TRUE)
}
```

## Appendix Table A1, last row: did estimates

Fits did on the restricted panel for both outcomes, with 10,000 bootstrap draws each. Writes
`analysis_panel.rds` and `bootstrap_fits.rds`.

```{r prior-gpa-effects}
# The result files of this row carry SPEC_ID in their first column: the project's identifier of this
# restricted-sample analysis, written on 2026-09-15 before the analysis first ran
SPEC_ID <- "ALLOC-PRIOR-UNEXPOSED-2026-09-15"
OUTCOMES <- c("gpa_z", "sh_prio")
set.seed(SEED_PRIOR)
restricted_data <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "restricted_panel.rds")))
restricted_data[, cell := paste(rbd, cod_nivel, sep = "|")]
restricted_data[, cell_id := as.integer(factor(cell))]
restricted_data[, G := as.integer(door + 1L)]
stopifnot("every restricted cell-year with a GPA mean counts all its entrants" =
            all(restricted_data[!is.na(gpa_z), n_ent] == restricted_data[!is.na(gpa_z), n_gpa]),
          "both outcomes are present in the same cell-years" =
            identical(is.na(restricted_data$gpa_z), is.na(restricted_data$sh_prio)))
saveRDS(restricted_data, file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "analysis_panel.rds"))
fits <- setNames(vector("list", length(OUTCOMES)), OUTCOMES)
for (outcome in OUTCOMES) {
  say("Fitting %s with %d bootstrap draws", outcome, as.integer(B_BOOT))
  fits[[outcome]] <- estimate_cs(restricted_data, outcome, as.integer(B_BOOT))   # did receives an integer count here
}
saveRDS(list(spec_id = SPEC_ID, seed = SEED_PRIOR, n_boot = as.integer(B_BOOT), fits = fits,
             session = sessionInfo()), file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "bootstrap_fits.rds"))
stopCluster(model_worker)
```
