## Appendix Table A1, last row: randomization test

Checks that the restricted outcomes rebuilt under the observed rollout equal the restricted panel, and
that the fast statistic equals the literal one under five rollouts; then scores the 9,999 saved
reassignments `prior_gpa`. Writes `permutation_assignments.rds`, `statistic_equivalence_checks.csv`,
`randomization_results.rds` and `undefined_permutation_draws.csv`.

```{r prior-gpa-permutations}
data.table::setDTthreads(1L)
context <- prepare_exposure_context(readRDS(file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "exposure_components.rds")))
observed_outcomes <- rebuild_exposure_outcomes(context, context$waves)
restricted_check <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "restricted_panel.rds")))
restricted_check <- merge(restricted_check, context$cells[, .(cell_id, rbd, cod_nivel)],
                          by = c("rbd", "cod_nivel"), all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
stopifnot(!anyNA(restricted_check$cell_id), !anyDuplicated(restricted_check[, .(cell_id, yr)]))
index <- restricted_check$cell_id + (match(restricted_check$yr, context$years) - 1L) * nrow(context$cells)
year_keys <- paste(context$cell_years$cell_id, context$cell_years$yr, sep = "|")
panel_year_keys <- paste(restricted_check$cell_id, restricted_check$yr, sep = "|")
year_match <- match(panel_year_keys, year_keys)
stopifnot(!anyNA(year_match),
          identical(is.na(restricted_check$gpa_z), is.na(restricted_check$sh_prio)),
          "the entrant counts rebuilt under the observed rollout equal the restricted panel's" =
            isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(restricted_check$n_ent), observed_outcomes$n_eligible[year_match],
                             tolerance = 1e-12, check.attributes = FALSE)),
          "no eligible cell-year lies outside the restricted panel" =
            !any(observed_outcomes$n_eligible[!year_keys %in% panel_year_keys] > 0L))
for (outcome in OUTCOMES) {
  stopifnot("the outcomes rebuilt under the observed rollout equal the restricted panel's" =
              isTRUE(all.equal(restricted_check[[outcome]], observed_outcomes[[outcome]][index],
                               tolerance = 1e-10, check.attributes = FALSE)),
            "the same number of cell-years with the outcome" =
              sum(!is.na(observed_outcomes[[outcome]])) == sum(!is.na(restricted_check[[outcome]])))
}
waves_matrix <- matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = B_RI, ncol = length(context$regions),
                       dimnames = list(NULL, as.character(context$regions)))
saved_waves <- wave_draws("prior_gpa", context$waves, B_RI)
for (draw in seq_len(B_RI)) waves_matrix[draw, ] <- saved_waves[[draw]]
saveRDS(list(spec_id = SPEC_ID, seed = SEED_PRIOR, regions = context$regions,
             observed = context$waves, assignments = waves_matrix),
        file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "permutation_assignments.rds"))
check_maps <- c(list(context$waves), lapply(c(1L, 2L, 17L, 100L),
                  function(i) setNames(waves_matrix[i, ], colnames(waves_matrix))))
equivalence_checks <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(check_maps), function(map_id) {
  check_waves <- check_maps[[map_id]]
  check_rebuilt <- rebuild_exposure_outcomes(context, check_waves)
  adoption <- unname(check_waves)[context$region_index] + 2L - context$cells$is_entry
  rbindlist(lapply(OUTCOMES, function(outcome) {
    fast <- jackknife_fast(check_rebuilt[[outcome]], adoption, context$years,
                           context$region_index, context$regions)
    literal <- jackknife_literal(check_rebuilt[[outcome]], adoption, context$years,
                                 context$cells$region, context$regions)
    stopifnot("the fast statistic equals the literal one" =
                isTRUE(all.equal(fast, literal, tolerance = 1e-9)))
    data.table(map_id = map_id, outcome = outcome,
               max_abs_difference = max(abs(fast - literal), na.rm = TRUE),
               n_valid_loo = fast[["n_valid_loo"]])
  }))
}))
fwrite(equivalence_checks, file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "statistic_equivalence_checks.csv"))
observed <- score_exposure_map(context$waves, context)
stopifnot("the observed randomization statistics are defined" = all(is.finite(observed)))
say("The restricted outcomes rebuilt under the observed rollout equal the restricted panel; the fast and literal statistics agree under five rollouts.")

results <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = B_RI, ncol = length(observed),
                  dimnames = list(NULL, names(observed)))
N_WORKERS <- worker_limit(rep(512 * 1024^2 + 4 * as.numeric(object.size(context)), N_CORES), N_CORES,
                          "randomization test of Table A1's last row")
cluster <- if (N_WORKERS > 1L) parallel::makeCluster(N_WORKERS) else NULL
worker_code <- list(context = context, rebuild_exposure_outcomes = rebuild_exposure_outcomes,
                    jackknife_fast = jackknife_fast, score_exposure_map = score_exposure_map)
for (name in c("rebuild_exposure_outcomes", "jackknife_fast", "score_exposure_map"))
  environment(worker_code[[name]]) <- .GlobalEnv
if (!is.null(cluster))
  parallel::clusterExport(cluster, names(worker_code), envir = list2env(worker_code))
score_map <- function(waves) score_exposure_map(waves, context)
environment(score_map) <- .GlobalEnv
tryCatch({
  if (!is.null(cluster))
    parallel::clusterEvalQ(cluster, { data.table::setDTthreads(1L); NULL })
  batch_size <- max(256L, 16L * N_WORKERS)
  for (start in seq.int(1L, B_RI, by = batch_size)) {
    ids <- seq.int(start, min(B_RI, start + batch_size - 1L))
    maps <- lapply(ids, function(i) setNames(waves_matrix[i, ], colnames(waves_matrix)))
    scored <- if (is.null(cluster)) lapply(maps, function(w) score_exposure_map(w, context)) else
      parallel::parLapplyLB(cluster, maps, score_map,
        chunk.size = max(1L, ceiling(length(maps) / (4L * N_WORKERS))))
    results[ids, ] <- do.call(rbind, scored)
    say("Scored %d / %d reassignments.", max(ids), B_RI)
  }
}, finally = if (!is.null(cluster)) parallel::stopCluster(cluster))
saveRDS(list(spec_id = SPEC_ID, seed = SEED_PRIOR, n_perm = B_RI,
             completed = B_RI, observed = observed, results = results,
             assignments = waves_matrix, checks = equivalence_checks, session = sessionInfo()),
        file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "randomization_results.rds"))
invalid <- which(!apply(is.finite(results), 1L, all))
fwrite(data.table(draw = invalid), file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "undefined_permutation_draws.csv"))
stopifnot("every reassignment's statistic is defined (stars need all 9,999)" = length(invalid) == 0L)
```

## Appendix Table A1, last row: results

Combines the did fits and the randomization test into the row's estimate, SE and randomization p.
Writes `restricted_results.csv` and `restricted_results.rds`.

```{r prior-gpa-results}
fit_bundle <- readRDS(file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "bootstrap_fits.rds"))
randomization <- readRDS(file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "randomization_results.rds"))
analysis_panel <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "analysis_panel.rds")))
stopifnot(identical(fit_bundle$spec_id, SPEC_ID), identical(randomization$spec_id, SPEC_ID),
          identical(randomization$completed, B_RI), nrow(randomization$results) == B_RI,
          all(is.finite(randomization$results)), all(is.finite(randomization$observed)),
          !any(vapply(fit_bundle$fits, is.null, logical(1L))))
rows <- lapply(OUTCOMES, function(outcome) {
  fit <- fit_bundle$fits[[outcome]]
  test_name <- paste0(outcome, "__statistic")
  paired_name <- paste0(outcome, "__att")
  ri_p <- (1L + sum(abs(randomization$results[, test_name]) >=
                      abs(randomization$observed[[test_name]]))) / (1L + B_RI)
  stars <- if (ri_p < .01) "***" else if (ri_p < .05) "**" else if (ri_p < .10) "*" else ""
  d <- analysis_panel[!is.na(get(outcome))]
  stopifnot(nrow(d) == fit$n_obs,
            isTRUE(all.equal(d[yr < G, mean(get(outcome))], fit$pre_mean, tolerance = 1e-12)))
  data.table(spec_id = SPEC_ID, outcome = outcome, att = fit$estimate, se = fit$se,
             ri_p = ri_p, stars = stars, pre_mean = fit$pre_mean, n_obs = fit$n_obs,
             n_cells = fit$n_cells, n_regions = fit$n_regions,
             eligible_entrant_records = sum(d$n_ent),
             observed_paired_att = randomization$observed[[paired_name]],
             paired_minus_did = randomization$observed[[paired_name]] - fit$estimate,
             ri_statistic = randomization$observed[[test_name]],
             n_boot = as.integer(B_BOOT), n_perm = B_RI, n_undefined = 0L)
})
restricted_summary <- rbindlist(rows)
fwrite(restricted_summary, file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "restricted_results.csv"))
saveRDS(restricted_summary, file.path(PRIOR_DIR, "restricted_results.rds"))
print(restricted_summary[, .(outcome, att, se, ri_p, stars, pre_mean, n_obs, n_cells)])
```

## Writing Table 1 and Appendix Tables A1 and A2

Writes the three table files the paper inputs (`tables/alloc_headline.tex`,
`tables/appendix14_a1_allocation.tex`, `tables/appendix14_a2_intake.tex`) and prints each table's
numbers. The Observations rows count the cell-years of 2012-2020: did keeps no cell-year of the last
adoption group's year or later, when every school-grade has adopted. Each count is checked against
the cell-years of a fit. Also writes `observations_estimate_years.csv` (each count, with the count
over every year) and `results.rds`.

## Numbers Section 2's text quotes

Prints the panel's counts, every event-time estimate of Figure 1 with its 95% interval, the joint
randomization tests of the leads, the GPA leads check, the paired estimates less did's, and the
Observations counts. Writes `event_time_estimates.csv`.

```{r text-numbers}
cells_region <- unique(CP[, .(cell, region)])
print(data.table(
  count = c("entrant child-years", "cell-years", "school-grades", "Metropolitan Region's share of the school-grades (%)"),
  value = c(format(c(sum(CP$n_ent), nrow(CP), nrow(cells_region)), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
            sprintf("%.1f", 100 * cells_region[, mean(region == 13L)]))))
# Figure 1: every event time the dynamic aggregation reports, with its pointwise 95% interval (the
# estimate plus or minus 1.96 SE, the figure's bars); the leads g-8 to g-2 are e = -8 to -2
event_times <- rbind(
  data.table(outcome = "Prior-year GPA (SD)", e = j_g$dynamic$egt, att = j_g$dynamic$att.egt, se = j_g$dynamic$se.egt),
  data.table(outcome = "Low-income share", e = j_p$dynamic$egt, att = j_p$dynamic$att.egt, se = j_p$dynamic$se.egt))[is.finite(att)]
event_times[, `:=`(lo = att - 1.96 * se, hi = att + 1.96 * se)]
event_times[, interval_excludes_zero := lo > 0 | hi < 0]
print(event_times)
fwrite(event_times, file.path(OUT_DIR, "event_time_estimates.csv"))
cat(sprintf("Joint randomization test of the leads g-6 to g-2 (%d reassignments): p = %.2f for the prior-year GPA, p = %.2f for the low-income share.\n\n",
            B_RI_ROBUST, rp_g$p, rp_p$p))
print(fread(file.path(OUT_DIR, "gpa_leads_check.csv")))
# the paired estimate (cells observed in both years of a comparison) less did's: Table 1 and Table A1's last row
print(data.table(estimate = c("Main estimate", "Prior grades earned before SAE coverage"),
                 gpa_sd = c(unname(obs_g["th"]) - g_reg$att, restricted_summary[outcome == "gpa_z", paired_minus_did]),
                 low_income_share = c(unname(obs_p["th"]) - p_reg$att, restricted_summary[outcome == "sh_prio", paired_minus_did])))
print(fread(file.path(OUT_DIR, "observations_estimate_years.csv")))
```
